players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh delivered two RBI via sacrifice flies as Seattle won the rubber game from Minnesota 5-3. He now leads the team with 18 RBIs on the season.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper's Wednesday game against San Francisco was rained out. The teams are expected to make it up as a doubleheader or separate date.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: The Giants-Phillies game was postponed for weather, giving Arraez an unplanned day off. He is batting .300 through 70 AB on the season.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette set the tone with a leadoff home run on the first pitch from Nationals starter Zack Littell, then added a sac fly for a 2-RBI night. The Mets blanked Washington 8-0 behind Clay Holmes and strong pitching.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle extended his hit streak to 12 games with an infield single in the 2nd, driving in a run. He scored on a pickoff-throw error before Detroit fell on a Braves walkoff, 4-3.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA hit a home run and drove in 3 runs as the Cubs edged the Padres 5-4 in San Diego. He is now batting .288 with 3 HR and 4 SBs on the season.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill went 1-for-4 with an RBI in San Diego's 5-4 loss to Chicago. The Padres bullpen could not hold the lead in the late innings.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez received a planned rest day as the Dodgers hosted Miami. He is expected back in the lineup Thursday.

players.name: Giancarlo Stanton
players.summary: Stanton remains on the injured list with no update on a return timeline.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams was not called upon in the Mets' 8-0 rout of Washington — no save situation arose. His ERA has climbed to 10.29 on the season; the club says minor mechanical adjustments are being made.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns struck out 9 over 6 innings and allowed 2 ER as Cincinnati routed Colorado 7-2. He improves to 4-1 with a 2.66 ERA — among the better SP values this fantasy season.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi delivered 7 scoreless innings vs. the Yankees, allowing only 4 hits while striking out 7. His ERA drops from 5.79 to 4.50 — a strong performance showing his ace-level upside.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans was not scheduled to pitch Wednesday; Michael Wacha started for KC vs. Oakland. Ragans has a 5.00 ERA in 5 starts but has averaged 5.4 innings per outing.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler's scheduled start was lost to the Giants-Phillies postponement. He last pitched April 25 and should stay on rotation for the next game.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan did not pitch Wednesday with Clayton Glasnow on the mound for LA. He holds a 3.71 ERA across 5 starts and is expected to pitch later in the week.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers sat out with Yusei Kikuchi starting for the Angels in a 3-2 loss to the White Sox. He carries a 3.89 ERA in 6 starts, right in line with projections.
